en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street view with a large, ornate late‑19th‑century civic building on the left, identified as the royal district court. The street extends into the distance with several historic buildings featuring steep roofs, dormers, and tower-like structures with spires. People walk along the sidewalk and a horse-drawn vehicle is visible. The bottom of the card bears red printed German text and a publisher's line in smaller type.
